searchField.description: Select the field whose text should be used to search on Forvo and Tatoeba.

audioField.description: Select the field where the audio should be put in.

sentenceField.description: Select the field where the sentence should be put in.

sentenceTranslationField.description: Select the field where the sentence translation should be put in.

sentenceAudioField.description: Select the field where the sentence audio should be put in.

language.description: The language of this deck that will be used to search on Forvo and Tatoeba. [See all possible options](https://github.com/realmayus/anki_forvo_dl/blob/main/assets/languages.json)

addTranscription.description: Adds the transcription of the sentence to the sentence field if available. This is done using HTML.

audioFieldAddMode.description: Allows you to specify how the audio string should be added to the audio field. You can choose between 'prepend', 'replace' and 'append'.

playAudioAfterAutomaticSelection.description: Play the audio after automatic add has completed successfully.

replaceCharacters.description: A list of characters that should be removed from the search term before searching on Forvo and Tatoeba.

configVersion.description: The current version of the config. Used for displaying the 'What's New' dialog.

skipOggFallback.description: Sometimes, only .ogg files are available for Forvo downloads. These unfortunately don't work on Anki's iOS app and are slightly bigger in size. This option allows you to skip those entries and remove them from the pronunciation list.

minSentenceAudioResults.description: The minimum amount of sentence audio results that should be fetched. After this count, we will stop fetching more results.

maxSentenceResults.description: The maximum amount of sentence results that should be fetched. After this count, we will stop fetching more results.
